shortfall_reason: No concept shortfall: 20 distinct concepts accepted after comparing all 60 source-claim fields against 18 reopened primary teaching/research/interview texts and the 22 original interaction entries. Five explicitly mapped existing-entry enrichments and fifteen distinct exercise concepts; not twenty new seed rows. No rejected records, observation/measurement claims, creative proposals or media candidates. Source line-number drift was resolved by named sections and paragraphs, not treated as an unsupported fact. Existing generic guides were not counted again; overlapping subject matter alone is not a duplicate exercise when role, goal and response rules differ. Unknown media rights remain conservative, including the paper whose article-level CC BY 4.0 terms were independently found with exceptions. Metadata-only review: zero media files acquired, inspected, generated or uploaded; no publication, seed change or Drive verification claimed.
